/// Optional GPU capabilities, returned by `context.features()`. When the device
/// is not known yet, `known` is false and every field holds a conservative
/// fallback.
export class GPUFeatures {
    /// True when the fields come from the device, false when they are
    /// fallbacks.
    known: bool = false;

    /// BC (S3TC/DXT) compressed texture formats supported.
    bc: bool;

    /// ETC2 compressed texture formats supported, common on mobile.
    etc2: bool;

    /// ASTC compressed texture formats supported.
    astc: bool;

    /// Maximum 2D texture width or height in texels.
    maxTextureSize2D: u32 = 4096;

    /// Maximum cube map face size in texels.
    maxTextureSizeCube: u32 = 4096;

    /// Maximum 3D texture depth or layer count.
    maxTextureSize3D: u32 = 256;

    /// Anisotropic texture filtering supported.
    anisotropicFiltering: bool;

    /// 3D textures supported.
    texture3D: bool;

    /// Texture arrays supported.
    textureArrays: bool;

    /// 32 bit float color render targets supported, such as `rgba32float`.
    colorBufferFloat: bool;

    /// 16 bit float color render targets supported, such as `rgba16float`.
    /// Implied by `colorBufferFloat`, but can be present without it on WebGL.
    colorBufferHalfFloat: bool;

    /// Independent blend state per color attachment supported.
    perTargetBlend: bool;

    /// Independent write mask per color attachment supported.
    perTargetWriteMask: bool;

    /// Nonzero `firstInstance` and `baseVertex` in draw calls supported.
    drawBaseInstance: bool;

    /// Depth bias clamping (`depthBiasClamp` on `GPUDepthStencilDesc`)
    /// supported.
    depthBiasClamp: bool;

    /// Maximum number of simultaneous color attachments.
    maxColorAttachments: u32 = 4;

    /// Maximum uniform buffer binding size in bytes.
    maxUniformBufferSize: u32 = 16384;

    /// Maximum number of samplers per shader stage.
    maxSamplers: u32 = 16;

    /// Maximum MSAA sample count for color render targets, always a power of
    /// two: 1, 2, 4 or 8.
    maxSamples: u32 = 4;

    /// What `GPURenderPass.setBindGroup`'s dynamic offsets must be a multiple
    /// of.
    minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment: u32 = 256;
}

/// A GPU buffer for vertex, index or uniform data.
export class GPUBuffer {
    /// Size in bytes.
    size: u32;

    /// Creates a buffer of `sizeInBytes` bytes for `usage`. When given,
    /// `data` is the initial contents and must be exactly `sizeInBytes`
    /// long. An `immutable` buffer takes its contents from `data` and cannot
    /// be updated afterward. Raises an error when `sizeInBytes` is 0, when
    /// `data` has another length, or when an `immutable` buffer has no `data`.
    ///
    /// The size is not checked against the shader's struct. Lay a uniform
    /// buffer out by hand to the WGSL alignment rules (`vec2` to 8 bytes,
    /// `vec3`, `vec4` and array elements to 16); a wrong offset reads garbage
    /// silently.
    unsafe constructor(usage: BufferUsage, sizeInBytes: u32, data: ArrayBuffer? = null, immutable: bool = false);

    /// Copies bytes of `data`, starting at byte `srcOffset`, into the buffer
    /// at byte offset `dstOffset`. `byteCount` limits the copy, so a region
    /// of an oversized staging buffer uploads without slicing; zero copies
    /// the rest of `data` from `srcOffset`.
    ///
    /// Raises an error when the buffer is immutable, when the source range
    /// runs past the end of `data`, or when the copy runs past the end of
    /// the buffer.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// // Uploads bytes 64 to 127 of staging to the start of the buffer.
    /// buffer.update(0, staging, 64, 64);
    /// ```
    unsafe update(dstOffset: u32, data: ArrayBuffer, byteCount: u32 = 0, srcOffset: u32 = 0): void;

    /// Releases the buffer now instead of when it is collected.
    release(): void;
}

    textureType: TextureType = TextureType.texture2D;

    /// Allows use as a render pass color attachment. Default false.
    renderTarget: bool = false;

    /// Number of mip levels. Default 1.
    numMipmaps: u32 = 1;

    /// MSAA sample count. Default 1, and above 1 only with `renderTarget`.

/// The defaults describe the whole texture.

    /// Number of mip levels. Zero, the default, takes all remaining levels.
    mipCount: u32 = 0;

/// A GPU texture: 2D, cube, 3D or array.

    /// Width of mip 0 in texels.

    /// Height of mip 0 in texels.

    /// Pixel format.

    /// Dimensionality.
    textureType: TextureType;

    /// Number of mip levels.
    numMipmaps: u32;

    /// MSAA sample count.

    /// Creates a texture from `desc`. Raises an error when `width` or
    /// `height` is 0, when `sampleCount` is not a power of two, or when the
    /// device rejects the descriptor.
    unsafe constructor(desc: GPUTextureDesc);

    /// Creates a view into a sub range of this texture; omit `desc` for the
    /// whole texture. Views are immutable. Create them once next to the
    /// texture and reuse them every frame; calling `view` in `draw` creates
    /// and destroys a native GPU object each frame.

    /// Releases the texture now instead of when it is collected.

/// pipeline. Build one from a shader with `fromShader`, then pass it in
/// `bindGroupLayouts` of `GPUPipelineDesc` at index N and to every

/// lights group reused by many materials.

    /// `fragment` when the pipeline's fragment stage comes from another
    /// shader, so the layout covers what either stage binds. Raises an error
    /// when `groupIndex` is 4 or more. Returns null when there is no GPU
    /// device or the device rejects the layout.
    static unsafe fromShader(
        module: GPUShaderModule,
        groupIndex: u32,
        dynamicUBOs: Array<u32> = [],
        fragment: GPUShaderModule? = null,
    ): GPUBindGroupLayout?;

    /// Releases the layout now instead of when it is collected.
    release(): void;
}

/// Blend equation for one color target. The defaults replace the
/// destination with the source.
///
/// ```as
/// let premultipliedOver = new GPUBlendState();
/// premultipliedOver.dstColor = BlendFactor.oneMinusSrcAlpha;
/// premultipliedOver.dstAlpha = BlendFactor.oneMinusSrcAlpha;

export class GPUBlendState {
    /// Factor on the source color. Default `one`.
    srcColor: BlendFactor = BlendFactor.one;

    /// Factor on the destination color. Default `zero`.
    dstColor: BlendFactor = BlendFactor.zero;

    /// Operation combining the color terms. Default `add`.
    colorOp: BlendOp = BlendOp.add;

    /// Factor on the source alpha. Default `one`.
    srcAlpha: BlendFactor = BlendFactor.one;

    /// Factor on the destination alpha. Default `zero`.
    dstAlpha: BlendFactor = BlendFactor.zero;

    /// Operation combining the alpha terms. Default `add`.
    alphaOp: BlendOp = BlendOp.add;
}

/// Stencil test and update for one triangle facing. The defaults always pass
/// and keep the stencil value.
export class GPUStencilFaceState {
    /// Comparison of the reference value against the stored stencil value.
    /// Default `always`.
    compare: CompareFunction = CompareFunction.always;

    /// What to write when the stencil test fails. Default `keep`.
    failOp: StencilOp = StencilOp.keep;

    /// What to write when the stencil test passes and the depth test fails.
    /// Default `keep`.

/// Depth and stencil test state of a pipeline. Leave `depthStencil` of
/// `GPUPipelineDesc` null to disable both.
///
/// Stencil needs a `depth24plusStencil8` or `depth32floatStencil8` depth
/// view. Each pass clears stencil to 0, and `setStencilReference` on the
/// pass sets the reference value.
///
/// ```as
/// // Marks covered pixels with 1.
/// let depth = new GPUDepthStencilDesc();
/// depth.format = TextureFormat.depth24plusStencil8;
/// depth.stencilFront.passOp = StencilOp.replace;
/// depth.stencilBack.passOp = StencilOp.replace;
/// ```
export class GPUDepthStencilDesc {
    /// Format of the depth attachment, such as `depth32float`. Must match
    /// the depth view of the pass.
    format: TextureFormat = TextureFormat.rgba8unorm;

    /// Comparison that decides whether a fragment passes. Default `always`.
    compare: CompareFunction = CompareFunction.always;

    /// Writes depth for passing fragments. Default false.
    write: bool = false;

    /// Constant depth bias. Default 0.
    depthBias: i32 = 0;

    /// Depth bias scaled by the slope of the primitive. Default 0.
    depthBiasSlopeScale: f32 = 0;

    /// Largest depth bias allowed; needs the `depthBiasClamp` feature.
    /// Default 0, no clamp.
    depthBiasClamp: f32 = 0;

    /// Stencil state for front facing triangles.
    stencilFront: GPUStencilFaceState = new GPUStencilFaceState();

    /// Stencil state for back facing triangles.
    stencilBack: GPUStencilFaceState = new GPUStencilFaceState();

    /// Bits of the stored stencil value the test reads. Default `0xFF`.
    stencilReadMask: u32 = 0xFF;

    /// Bits of the stored stencil value the ops write. Default `0xFF`.
    stencilWriteMask: u32 = 0xFF;
}

/// Descriptor for the `GPUPipeline` constructor.
///
/// Vertex and fragment may come from different shaders. Each file's bindings
/// are numbered on its own, so on Vulkan, D3D12 and GL, which share one slot
/// namespace between the stages, two files that declare different bindings
/// can collide; the `GPUPipeline` constructor rejects that case naming both
/// bindings. Declaring the same bindings in both files always works.
export class GPUPipelineDesc {
    /// Shader for the vertex stage. Required.
    vertexModule: GPUShaderModule? = null;

    /// Name of the vertex shader's `@vertex` function. Empty, the default,
    /// takes the first one.
    vertexEntryPoint: string = "";

    /// Shader for the fragment stage. When null, a pipeline with color
    /// targets takes the fragment entry from `vertexModule`, and one without
    /// them is depth only.
    fragmentModule: GPUShaderModule? = null;

    /// Name of the fragment shader's `@fragment` function. Empty, the
    /// default, takes the first one.
    fragmentEntryPoint: string = "";

    /// Color target formats and blending, one per color attachment of the
    /// pass, up to 4.
    colorTargets: Array<GPUColorTargetDesc> = [];

    /// Vertex buffer layouts, one per vertex buffer slot. Leave it empty for
    /// a shader that builds its positions from `@builtin(vertex_index)`.
    vertexBuffers: Array<GPUVertexBufferLayout> = [];

    /// Bind group layouts, where index N serves `@group(N)`, with null
    /// entries for unused groups. Leave it empty, the default, to derive one
    /// layout per group from the shader, like WebGPU's `layout: 'auto'`, and
    /// read them back with `getBindGroupLayout`. Supply layouts built with
    /// `GPUBindGroupLayout.fromShader` to share one across several
    /// pipelines, so a single bind group, such as a per frame camera and
    /// lights group, serves all of them. Derived layouts cover both stages
    /// when the vertex and fragment come from different shaders.
    bindGroupLayouts: Array<GPUBindGroupLayout?> = [];

    /// Primitive topology. Default `triangleList`.
    topology: PrimitiveTopology = PrimitiveTopology.triangleList;

    /// Index format of indexed strip draws, which restart the strip at the
    /// format's largest value. Default `none`.
    indexFormat: IndexFormat = IndexFormat.none;

    /// Face culling. Default `none`.
    cullMode: CullMode = CullMode.none;

    /// Winding of front faces. Default `counterClockwise`.
    winding: FaceWinding = FaceWinding.counterClockwise;

    /// Depth test state, or null to disable depth testing. Default null.
    depthStencil: GPUDepthStencilDesc? = null;

    /// MSAA sample count. Must match the sample count of the pass's
    /// attachments. Default 1.
    sampleCount: u32 = 1;
}

/// A compiled GPU render pipeline: shaders plus fixed function state.
export class GPUPipeline {
    /// Creates a pipeline from `desc`. Raises an error when `desc` has more
    /// than 4 color targets or bind group layouts, or when the device
    /// rejects the descriptor. A missing vertex shader or an entry point
    /// that does not resolve leaves the pipeline empty, and setting it on a
    /// pass does nothing.
    unsafe constructor(desc: GPUPipelineDesc);

    /// Returns the layout the pipeline derived for `@group(groupIndex)`, for
    /// building a `GPUBindGroup`, like WebGPU's `getBindGroupLayout`. Raises
    /// an error when the pipeline was given `bindGroupLayouts`, whose layouts
    /// serve instead, or when the shader does not use the group.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let desc = new GPUPipelineDesc();
    /// desc.vertexModule = shader;
    /// desc.colorTargets = [new GPUColorTargetDesc()];
    /// let pipeline = new GPUPipeline(desc);
    /// let group = new GPUBindGroup(
    ///     pipeline.getBindGroupLayout(0),
    ///     [new GPUBindGroupUBO(0, uniforms)]);
    /// ```
    getBindGroupLayout(groupIndex: u32): GPUBindGroupLayout;

    /// Releases the pipeline now instead of when it is collected, along with
    /// its hold on the layouts it derived.
    release(): void;
}

/// A color attachment of a render pass.
export class GPUColorAttachment {
    /// The view to render into, or null for the `view` of the target the
    /// pass begins on. Set it when the target differs, most commonly for
    /// MSAA, where `view` is a multisampled texture's view and
    /// `resolveTarget` is the target's own `view`.
    view: GPUTextureView? = null;

    /// Single sampled view that a multisampled `view` resolves into. Its
    /// format must match `view`.
    resolveTarget: GPUTextureView? = null;

    /// What to do with the attachment when the pass begins. Default `clear`.
    loadOp: LoadOp = LoadOp.clear;

    /// What to do with the attachment when the pass ends: `discard` after an
    /// MSAA resolve, `store` otherwise. Default `store`.
    storeOp: StoreOp = StoreOp.store;

    /// Red of the clear color. Values above 1 are kept on float targets.
    clearR: f32 = 0;

    /// Green of the clear color.
    clearG: f32 = 0;

    /// Blue of the clear color.
    clearB: f32 = 0;

    /// Alpha of the clear color. Default 1, so the default clear is opaque
    /// black.
    clearA: f32 = 1;
}

/// Descriptor for `beginRenderPass`. It needs at least one color attachment
/// or a depth view. All attachments share one sample count, which the pass
/// takes from its views.
export class GPUPassDesc {
    /// Color attachments, up to 4.
    color: Array<GPUColorAttachment> = [];

    /// Depth attachment, from a depth texture's `view`, or null for none.
    depthView: GPUTextureView? = null;

    /// What to do with depth when the pass begins. Default `clear`.
    depthLoadOp: LoadOp = LoadOp.clear;

    /// What to do with depth when the pass ends: `discard` for transient
    /// depth, `store` to read it later. Default `discard`.
    depthStoreOp: StoreOp = StoreOp.discard;

    /// Depth the `clear` load op fills with. Default 1.
    depthClearValue: f32 = 1.0;

    /// Names the pass in Vulkan GPU profiles and Metal or WebGPU captures.
    label: string = "";
}

/// An open render pass. Issue its draw calls, then call `finish`.
export class GPURenderPass {
    /// Sets the pipeline for the draws that follow. Raises an error when the
    /// pipeline does not fit the pass's attachments.
    setPipeline(pipeline: GPUPipeline): void;

    /// Binds `bindGroup` to `@group(groupIndex)`. `dynamicOffsets` holds one
    /// byte offset per dynamic uniform buffer in the group, in the order of
    /// the group's uniform buffer entries; see `dynamicUBOs` in
    /// `GPUBindGroupLayout.fromShader`. A typical 3D pattern binds a shared
    /// texture group at 1 and a per object uniform buffer with a dynamic
    /// offset at 0.
    unsafe setBindGroup(groupIndex: u32, bindGroup: GPUBindGroup, dynamicOffsets: Array<u32> = []): void;

    /// Binds a vertex buffer to `slot`, the index of its layout in
    /// `vertexBuffers` of `GPUPipelineDesc`, reading from byte `offset`.
    setVertexBuffer(slot: u32, buffer: GPUBuffer, offset: u32 = 0): void;

    /// Binds an index buffer, reading from byte `offset`. `indexFormat` is an
    /// `IndexFormat` value, such as `<u32>IndexFormat.uint16`.
    setIndexBuffer(buffer: GPUBuffer, indexFormat: u32, offset: u32 = 0): void;

    /// Sets the viewport in pixels and its depth range. The origin is the
    /// top left on every backend except GL, where it is the bottom left.
    setViewport(x: f32, y: f32, width: f32, height: f32, minDepth: f32 = 0, maxDepth: f32 = 1): void;

    /// Sets the scissor rectangle in pixels.
    setScissor(x: u32, y: u32, width: u32, height: u32): void;

    /// Sets the stencil reference value that the pipeline's stencil test
    /// compares against and the `replace` stencil op writes. See
    /// `stencilFront` and `stencilBack` of `GPUDepthStencilDesc`.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// pass.setStencilReference(1);
    /// ```
    setStencilReference(reference: u32): void;

    /// Sets the constant color that the `blendColor` and
    /// `oneMinusBlendColor` blend factors read, as 0 to 1 channels.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// // Blends the source in at a constant 25 percent.
    /// let blend = new GPUBlendState();
    /// blend.srcColor = BlendFactor.blendColor;
    /// blend.dstColor = BlendFactor.oneMinusBlendColor;
    /// pass.setBlendColor(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25);
    /// ```
    setBlendColor(r: f32, g: f32, b: f32, a: f32): void;

    /// Draws `vertexCount` vertices without an index buffer. A nonzero
    /// `firstInstance` needs the `drawBaseInstance` feature. Raises an error
    /// when no pipeline is set.
    draw(vertexCount: u32, instanceCount: u32 = 1, firstVertex: u32 = 0, firstInstance: u32 = 0): void;

    /// Draws `indexCount` indices from the index buffer. A nonzero
    /// `baseVertex` or `firstInstance` needs the `drawBaseInstance` feature.
    /// Raises an error when no pipeline is set.
    drawIndexed(indexCount: u32, instanceCount: u32 = 1, firstIndex: u32 = 0, baseVertex: i32 = 0, firstInstance: u32 = 0): void;

    /// Submits the pass, along with any pass begun inside it that is still
    /// open. Later calls on this pass do nothing.
    finish(): void;
}

/// Something a render pass can draw into. It promises neither sampling nor
/// contents kept between frames; `GPUCanvas` adds both. `context.gpuTarget()`
/// returns Rive's own render target as one.
export class GPUTarget {
    /// Width in pixels.
    get width(): u32;

    /// Height in pixels.
    get height(): u32;

    /// Pixel format, as a `TextureFormat` value. An MSAA resolve needs
    /// source and target of identical formats, so derive texture and
    /// pipeline formats from this value.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let color = new GPUColorTargetDesc();
    /// color.format = <TextureFormat>target.format;
    /// let desc = new GPUPipelineDesc();
    /// desc.vertexModule = shader;
    /// desc.fragmentModule = shader;
    /// desc.colorTargets = [color];
    /// desc.sampleCount = 4;
    /// ```
    get format(): u32;

    /// Samples per pixel. Always 1 for a canvas; can be above 1 for
    /// `context.gpuTarget()` on some hosts.
    get sampleCount(): u32;

    /// View of the target, for a color attachment or an MSAA resolve target.
    /// Null on a frame with nothing to draw into. Read it each frame; a view
    /// kept across a resize errors when a pass uses it.
    get view(): GPUTextureView?;

    /// Opens a render pass. A color attachment with a null `view` renders
    /// into this target; set views explicitly to render elsewhere, as for
    /// MSAA. Call it while drawing, issue draw calls on the returned pass,
    /// then call `finish`. Pass `into` to reuse a pass object from an
    /// earlier frame instead of allocating one.
    ///
    /// A pass may begin while another is open, as when a drawn artboard's
    /// own scripts render: it runs ahead of the pass it was begun inside, so
    /// that pass can sample its output. With nothing to draw into, the pass
    /// drops its commands.
    unsafe beginRenderPass(desc: GPUPassDesc, into: GPURenderPass? = null): GPURenderPass;
}

/// A `GPUTarget` the script owns, like a WebGPU surface texture: single
/// sampled, kept between frames and sampleable. Render into it with
/// `beginRenderPass`, then composite `image` with `drawImage` on a
/// `Renderer`, or sample it in a later pass through `view`. For MSAA, render
/// into a multisampled `GPUTexture` made with `renderTarget` and resolve into
/// the canvas's `view`.
///
/// ```as
/// let canvas = context.gpuCanvas(256, 256);
/// if (canvas != null) {
///     let color = new GPUColorAttachment();
///     color.loadOp = LoadOp.clear;
///     color.storeOp = StoreOp.store;
///     let desc = new GPUPassDesc();
///     desc.color = [color];
///     let pass = canvas.beginRenderPass(desc);
///     pass.setPipeline(pipeline);
///     pass.draw(3);
///     pass.finish();
///     renderer.drawImage(canvas.image, sampler, BlendMode.srcOver, 1);
/// }
/// ```
export class GPUCanvas extends GPUTarget {
    /// Width in pixels.
    get width(): u32;

    /// Height in pixels.
    get height(): u32;

    /// Pixel format, as a `TextureFormat` value. Known even before a canvas
    /// created at zero size allocates its texture.
    get format(): u32;

    /// View of the canvas's backing texture, for a color attachment, an MSAA
    /// resolve target, or sampling in a later pass. The same view as `view`,
    /// but raises an error instead of answering null when the canvas has no
    /// backing yet, as when created at zero size.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let color = new GPUColorAttachment();
    /// color.view = msaaView;
    /// color.resolveTarget = canvas.colorView();
    /// color.storeOp = StoreOp.discard;
    /// ```
    colorView(): GPUTextureView;

    /// The image holding what the canvas rendered, for `drawImage` on a
    /// `Renderer`. It is never null, and a reference kept across a resize
    /// follows the new backing.
    get image(): Image;

    /// Creates a canvas of the given size in pixels. A zero size allocates
    /// nothing until `resize`. `context.gpuCanvas()` does the same and
    /// answers null when the host cannot make a canvas.
    constructor(width: u32, height: u32);

    /// Resizes the canvas, recreating its backing texture. Returns false,
    /// leaving the canvas as it was, when the size is zero or the device
    /// refuses it. Multisampled or depth textures sized to the canvas must
    /// be recreated to match.
    resize(width: u32, height: u32): bool;

    /// Releases the canvas and its backing now instead of when it is
    /// collected.
    release(): void;
}
```
